decisive_items: a radiological diagnosis of juvenile ossifying fibroma of the right posterior maxilla was made
the margin of the swelling was well-defined and well demarcated from the surrounding areas which was very much unlike FD whose margin is ill-defined and merges with the surrounding areas
response.rationale: The vignette explicitly states a radiological diagnosis of juvenile ossifying fibroma, and the well-defined margin is cited as distinguishing it from fibrous dysplasia, which is described as ill-defined. R1 is directly supported; R2 is contradicted by the same margin criterion.

rejected.why: Explicitly deemed less likely because its margin is ill-defined, contrary to the well-defined swelling described.
